runtime: Selenium 4.51.0 + Pillow in a dedicated disposable environment, no changes to application dependencies

execution.viewport_control: Native WebDriver BiDi setViewport with devicePixelRatio1; no mobile OS/touch claim
execution.security: Fresh isolated driver-created profiles; certificate validation enabled; no sandbox/GPU disabling, injected missing APIs, test routing/mocks, browser-global or app-state overrides.
execution.data: Public deployed saved-data UI; compare payload bytes to pinned repository separately; no inference, GT or tracking rerun.
execution.UI: Use native WebDriver select, pointer, key, wheel and shift-drag actions. Read visible DOM outputs. Capture original screenshots, do not edit media. Read-only canvas pixels/screenshot differences support rendering checks.
execution.console: Subscribe native WebDriver BiDi console/error events before navigation; keep raw events local and classify page errors separately from browser warnings.
execution.B02: For each engine in v0.1/v0.2, verify actual point pixels; compare before/after native rotate, zoom, shift-pan, size, RGB/depth and reset. Visually inspect stored screenshots; DOM success alone is insufficient.
execution.B03_B04: Independent stdlib Float32/RLE/K oracle using actual displayed source pixel; same frozen tolerance. Four models, centre/edge both canvases; Segment/Detect bus count/confidence/median, all-objects restore.
execution.B05: Frozen frame/gap boundaries/statistics/buttons and speeds; capture real history gaps without fabricated observations.
execution.B06: Home/three versions in both languages at desktop and supplemental390px, verify visible version links, images, state and controls; no horizontal overflow.
execution.B08: Preserve each unexercised natural no-gzip/Canvas branch as not_run. An available supported browser is not a fallback test; do not manufacture unsupported APIs.
execution.failure_policy: Retain every scheduled browser/case, failed assertions, setup/harness failures and zero/not_run outcomes. Distinguish harness defects and reruns from app defects; no silent passing rerun.
execution.acceptance: New rows are headless evidence at these exact builds, not universal headed/OS/mobile support. Original in-app records, failures, amendment and unmeasured rows remain immutable.
execution.publication: Only source harness, execution plan, aggregate results/hashes and reviewed public-data evidence. Original logs, screenshots, binary packages, profiles and driver details with local paths remain local.
